author: NaomiM393

title: Great experience.
text: Great tour, covered a few different neighbourhoods, and tried several dishes, all delicious.  Alfonso was an excellent guide, knowledgeable and engaging.
author: Destination290718

title: A must do for any foodie
text:
I loved this experience so much. I often do food tours as a way to explore new places, and this one was one of my favourites. Alfonso the guide was so friendly and knowledgeable. All the food and drink were amazing and I got to try interesting items I would never have tried if i had been on my own.

The tour was a good pace and we got to see variously parts of the city. Alfonso was also very helpful in recommending more places to visit, plus souvenirs or foods to buy. It really was an incredible way to experience Seville.
author: annzradenitan

title: The perfect introduction to Seville with an incredible host
text:
We booked the Eating Seville Tapas, Drinks, and Local Flavours tour for our first night in the city, and it was the ideal way to kick off our weekend break. There were five of us in our family, joining a full, intimate group of 12.
The absolute star of the evening was our host, Alfonso. He was warm, endearing, and made a genuine effort to connect with every single person in the group. As a local, he packed the walk with fascinating history, great insider tips, and brilliant advice for the rest of our trip.

title: Very exciting and tasty!
text: We did not know much about Spanish cuisine until we met our tour guide Alphonso. He was super knowledgeable about the history of the area/traditions to Sevilla that influence the dishes we tried. Highly recommend.
author: ebonim246

title: Best Eating Tour
text: The tour was fantastic. Our guide Alfonso was amazing. He was very friendly and knowledgeable about the area and the food we had. He laughed and joked with us and even took the time to remember our names (which is impressive since he meets soo many people weekly). After the tour, he stood by giving everyone recommendations on how to spend the rest of the weekend. If Alfonso is giving the tour, I’d pay to do it again!
author: mcbridenavy

title: Highly recommended!
text: Alfonso was a fantastic guide, and every single tapas dish was delicious. Our whole group had an amazing experience!
author: MMRKells

title: Highly Recommend!
text: A true 5 star tour! Alfonso was an incredible host. All the food and wine choices were amazing and I loved hearing the history of each neighbourhood we visited. The absolute perfect introduction to the food, culture and people of Sevilla! Thank you Alfonso you were brilliant!
author: B5087AWsherryh

title: Delicious food + history/culture for a great price!
text: I highly recommend this tour! It’s a great value for the money and we also learnt so much more about the history an culture of Seville. Our guide, Samuel, was great and very knowledgeable about all the places we went as well as the city. The 2 hours flew by and we all left feeling absolutely stuffed! It was a great time :)
author: poojac96
